rows.note: Use 喜劇 as the all-purpose noun for a comedy play, the comedy genre, or general comedy entertainment.

example.english: We’re watching a comedy tonight and laughing till our stomachs hurt.
example.traditional: 我哋今晚睇套喜劇，笑到肚痛。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 maan5 tai2 tou3 hei2 kek6 siu3 dou3 tou5 tung3

rows.note: Use 棟篤笑 for stand-up comedy, rather than comedy in general.

example.english: They did stand-up comedy at the Cultural Centre last night and had us laughing nonstop.
example.traditional: 佢噚晚喺文化中心做棟篤笑，講到我哋笑到停唔到。
example.jyutping: keoi5 cam4 maan5 hai2 man4 faa3 zung1 sam1 zou6 dung3 duk1 siu3 gong2 dou3 ngo5 dei6 siu3 dou3 ting4 m4 dou2

rows.note: Use 趣事 for an amusing incident or anecdote, not for a comedy work.

example.english: That incident was really a comedy.
example.jyutping: go2 gin6 si6 zan1 hai6 jat1 gin6 ceoi3 si6
